rules.name: notify_owner
rules.why: only owner adds rewards

rules.name: acc_auth
rules.why: index only grows via owner reward

rules.name: acc_monotone
rules.why: reward index only rises

rules.name: owner_auth
rules.why: owner protected

rules.name: stake_ledger
rules.why: total staked equals sum of stakes

rules.name: stake_resets_debt
rules.expr: ok and called("stake") and post("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt") != wide(post("userInfo", sender, "amount")) * wide(post("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000
rules.why: stake checkpoints reward debt so past rewards are not re-earned

rules.name: withdraw_resets_debt
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and post("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt") != wide(post("userInfo", sender, "amount")) * wide(post("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000
rules.why: withdraw checkpoints reward debt so past rewards are not re-earned

rules.name: importLegacy_resets_debt
rules.expr: ok and called("importLegacy") and post("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt") != wide(post("userInfo", sender, "amount")) * wide(post("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000
rules.why: importLegacy checkpoints reward debt so past rewards are not re-earned

rules.name: claim_resets_debt
rules.expr: ok and called("claim") and post("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt") != wide(post("userInfo", sender, "amount")) * wide(post("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000
rules.why: claim checkpoints reward debt so past rewards are not re-earned

rules.name: harvest_bounded
rules.expr: ok and not called("notifyReward") and not called("MockToken_RWD.transferFrom") and not called("MockToken_RWD.transfer") and wide(post("MockToken_RWD.balanceOf", sender) - pre("MockToken_RWD.balanceOf", sender)) > wide(pre("userInfo", sender, "amount")) * wide(pre("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000 - pre("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt")
rules.why: a pool call pays at most the caller's pending reward; direct reward-token transfers/transferFrom to the caller are unrelated and excluded

rules.name: rewards_out_only_to_sender
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and not called("MockToken_RWD.transferFrom") and post("MockToken_RWD.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken_RWD.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: no reward token loss for others (excluding legitimate transferFrom by an approved spender)

rules.name: stake_token_no_third_party
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and u != A3 and not called("MockToken_STK.transferFrom") and post("MockToken_STK.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken_STK.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: no stake token loss for others (excluding legitimate transferFrom by an approved spender)

rules.name: userinfo_no_third_party
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and post("userInfo", u, "amount") < pre("userInfo", u, "amount")
rules.why: no one loses stake in others' calls

rules.name: legacy_no_third_party
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and post("LegacyPool.balanceOf", u) < pre("LegacyPool.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: no one loses legacy balance in others' calls

rules.name: stake_credit
rules.why: stake credits amount

rules.name: stake_pull
rules.why: stake takes amount

rules.name: withdraw_debit
rules.why: withdraw debits amount

rules.name: withdraw_pay
rules.why: withdraw pays amount

rules.name: import_matches_legacy
rules.expr: ok and called("importLegacy") and post("userInfo", sender, "amount") - pre("userInfo", sender, "amount") != pre("LegacyPool.balanceOf", sender) - post("LegacyPool.balanceOf", sender)
rules.why: imported stake equals migrated legacy balance

rules.name: claim_no_stake_change
rules.expr: ok and called("claim") and (post("userInfo", sender, "amount") != pre("userInfo", sender, "amount") or post("totalStaked") != pre("totalStaked"))
rules.why: claim does not change stake

rules.name: migrate_only_migrator
rules.why: only migrator migrates

rules.name: withdraw_exit
rules.why: stakers can always withdraw

rules.name: claim_live
rules.why: claims never get stuck

rules.name: rwd_ledger
rules.why: reward token conservation

rules.name: import_receives_tokens
rules.expr: ok and called("importLegacy") and post("MockToken_STK.balanceOf", A0) - pre("MockToken_STK.balanceOf", A0) != post("userInfo", sender, "amount") - pre("userInfo", sender, "amount")
rules.why: imported stake is credited only for stake tokens actually received

rules.name: import_no_reward_windfall
rules.expr: ok and called("importLegacy") and wide(post("userInfo", sender, "amount")) * wide(post("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000 - post("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt") > wide(pre("userInfo", sender, "amount")) * wide(pre("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000 - pre("userInfo", sender, "rewardDebt")
rules.why: adding stake must not create pending rewards for the past

invariants.name: pending_backed
invariants.expr: wide(post("userInfo", u, "amount")) * wide(post("accRewardPerShare")) // 1000000000000 - post("userInfo", u, "rewardDebt") > post("MockToken_RWD.balanceOf", A0)
invariants.why: each user's pending reward is backed
